about: A timeline down the frame that draws itself to each event as it is said, with its date and what happened, spaced by the real time between them: history, a life, a process over days or years, a sequence of dates.

dates.about: each event's date or time, split by |

highlight.about: dates or events drawn larger in the accent, split by |

even.about: 1 spaces the events evenly instead of by their dates

when.about: moments the line reaches each event; else when its date or words are said, or one after another
